primitives.name: Single-Market Arbitrage Scan
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Buy path (long arbitrage):** simultaneously buy all outcomes at the ask when Ask_A + Ask_B < 1.00.
primitives.assumptions: Market completeness; no transaction fees; perfect liquidity at top-of-book.

layer2.mapping: GSE tracks cross-market dependencies between moneyline and spread; GSI models structural mispricing using conditional probability distributions.

These are grounded in the fundamental principle that complementary outcomes must sum to 1.00 in a frictionless market. The system assumes top-of-book liquidity and zero transaction costs, enabling precise detection of mispricings. Failure modes include polling latency, which can miss fast-moving opportunities, and liquidity constraints that prevent execution. The derived kernel of these primitives maps to GSE’s real-time monitoring and GSI’s probabilistic inference on market efficiency. The dual nature of the operators—long and short—reflects symmetric market dynamics and enables robust validation against adversarial behavior.
